_comment: Task family taxonomy for the refine loop (issue #239, P1 prerequisite). New families require a PR. Families are used for: trigger routing, held-out regression selection, and lessons-library retrieval.

branch-hygiene.description: Branch cleanup, merge verification, stale-branch audits.

code-fix.description: Implementing a code fix for a reported bug or failure.

docs.description: Documentation writes or updates: canon, handoff, README, guides.

issue-triage.description: Triaging a GitHub issue: classification, severity, routing to lanes.

plan-assessment.description: Assessing a plan with Jev: completeness, scoring, readiness verdict.

pr-review.description: Reviewing a pull request: CI state, diff assessment, merge recommendation.

research.description: Research tasks: web search, paper verification, competitive analysis.

test-gap.description: Test authoring, coverage work, test isolation fixes.
